syntactic_simplification:
Mice are important in neuroscience research. They help scientists learn about the brain. Researchers can control and study mice easily. 

In the past, researchers preferred male mice for experiments. They did this because female mice have hormone cycles. These cycles can change behavior. This may affect the results of the experiments.
lexical_simplification:
Mice are important in brain research. They help scientists learn about how the brain works. Researchers can control and study mice easily.

In the past, researchers liked to use male mice for experiments. They did this because female mice have hormone cycles. These cycles can change how they behave. This may affect the results of the experiments.
paraphrase_or_explanation:
Mice are important in brain research. They help scientists learn about how the brain works. Researchers can easily control and study mice.

In the past, researchers liked to use male mice for experiments. They did this because female mice have hormone cycles. A hormone cycle is a natural process that affects how female mice feel and act. These changes can influence their behavior. This may change the results of the experiments.

source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text:
Mice are important in brain research. They help scientists learn about how the brain works. Researchers can easily control and study mice.

In the past, researchers liked to use male mice for experiments. They did this because female mice have hormone cycles. This means their feelings and actions can change. These changes can affect how they behave and might change the results of the experiments.
